svg.title: Smart Parking QR session flow on AWS
svg.desc: The user reserves a parking slot and uses the same QR code at check-in and checkout. Amazon S3 stores gate and parking images, AWS Lambda calls Amazon Rekognition for slot occupancy detection, Amazon RDS stores the booking, session, and fee, and Amazon CloudWatch records operational logs.
svg.text: Booking, gate verification, slot occupancy analysis, checkout, and fee recording
